people.name: 藤桥·新雨
people.role: 沉斑的学徒。终章举起香盏的人。不是第十三名同伴。

people.name: 石垒·晚担
people.role: 石垒坡同乡。因人而留的第一人。不是十二同伴。
people.look: broad-shouldered young quarry carrier from the stone slope, sun-darkened skin, short black hair, rope-padded shoulder strap, plain work jacket

people.name: 老旗手
people.look: weathered retired standard-bearer, short cropped grey beard, a broken flagpole iron ferrule on a cord at his neck, patched slate coat

people.name: 管事
people.look: castle steward with a ledger tucked under one arm, neat short hair, rolled sleeves, practical waistcoat

people.name: 稳婆
people.look: village midwife, grey hair under a head scarf, kind firm face, sleeves tied up, clean linen over the shoulder

people.name: 掌柜
people.look: tavern keeper, stocky, short greying beard, apron over a dark shirt, cloth over one shoulder

people.name: 春令使者
people.look: envoy of the spring council, hair in a tidy braid, formal slate travelling cloak with a sealed letter case, poised expression

people.name: 斥候
people.look: company scout, short practical hair, hood down, light leather and cloth gear, keen alert eyes

people.name: 盟友亲属
people.look: senior relative of an allied house giving a bride away, composed and formal, hair pinned up with a plain pin, layered formal robe

people.name: 渡口·把头
people.role: 苇原渡粮队的把头。不是同伴。
people.look: ferry grain-convoy foreman, thick forearms, headband, sleeveless padded vest, weathered face

people.name: 渡口·阿禾
people.role: 灯影临时雇来引开视线的孩子。不是初啼。

people.name: 镜湖·护帖
people.role: 霜冕护送队长。聘书上没有他的姓被写成继承人。

people.name: 冷窑·收火
people.role: 循烟灰来要人的窑债主。

people.name: 槐里·景伯
people.role: 第零章的恩主。灰旗堡地契与北隘护路契在他家。年轻时在灰旗站过七天，功被记在旗帅一人名下。要把隘口之功写给孙女。不是反派。
people.look: elderly landed patron of the Huaili house, white hair combed back, trimmed white beard, dignified high-collared long coat, holds a folded deed

people.name: 槐里·青禾
people.role: 景伯的孙女。颈有河图不亮。不要借来的灯。第零章的配偶候选之一，联姻廷里仍由玩家选人。
people.look: granddaughter of the old patron, a composed young woman with long dark hair half tied up, high collar hiding the neck, steady direct gaze, slim riding jacket

people.name: 鸦渡·衡舟
people.role: 槐里家骑哨统领。平民出身，十年换一个錾在铜牌上的村名。收过路银，往东送。团长的镜子。
people.look: commoner-born captain of mounted scouts, lean face, short dark hair, small engraved metal tag on his chest strap, light scout armour

people.name: 石垒·荞娘
people.role: 团长的娘。押出采石坡租契的人。
people.look: the leader's mother, a quarry-village widow, hair tied back in a low bun with grey strands, calm tired eyes, plain wrapped shawl over a work dress

people.name: 活口
people.role: 隘口活口。左耳缺一块。见过收银的人。
people.look: captured pass bandit survivor, part of his left ear missing, bruised cheek, rope-bound wrists, ragged dark clothes

people.name: 新来的人
people.role: 第零章已有的声音：上个老板欠饷的新雇佣兵
people.look: newly hired mercenary, unshaven, holds a worn pay booklet with circled pages, dented gorget, wary eyes
